notes.title: Last Chance in Xollywood Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35542689/520d6d6ca1c2b068f7471e6f1e9a1b00e7d4d44d.png[/img]
[b]Last Chance in Xollywood[/b], the new game from the creators of Void Pyramid, is now released.

In this sci-fi [b]RPG/visual novel[/b], you are an extraterrestrial movie director at a low-budget movie studio. Struggle against capitalism, corruption, and your eccentric coworkers to get the movie done on time and under budget.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096220/Last_Chance_in_Xollywood

notes.title: Superstorm Melon Date Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey people! I made a new game, and it's free!

It's date night in the dystopian future. Hit the town with Mel, a melon-person with psychic powers. Choose where to go, what to do, and what to say in this highly interactive, romance visual novel.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509830/Superstorm_Melon_Date/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509830/Superstorm_Melon_Date/[/url]

notes.title: Xoo: Xeno Xafari Coming August 7th
notes.notes:
[b]Get your sleeping bag and trail mix ready. Your trip to Xoo Island starts August 7th.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339180/Xoo_Xeno_Xafari/]Xoo: Xeno Xafari on Steam[/url]

[b]What is this?[/b] It's your summer vacation on Xoo Island! This beautiful, deserted island is populated by a surreal menagerie of alien creatures. Can you find them all? While you're at it, you might as well collect a bunch of fossils, gems, eggs, merit badges, video games, and anything else that isn't nailed down. Xoo: Xeno Xafari is a new style of collecting RPG.
